events.evidence: The Saudi Arabia led coalition launches airstrikes on military bases near the Yemeni capital Sanaa
Pro-Russian separatists launch an offensive to take Marinka, Ukraine, 5 kilometers from the separatist capital of Donetsk. At least 19 people have died in fighting.
South Korea has successfully test fired two ballistic missiles that can hit all of North Korea
